title: Multi-Policy Discount Restart Credit on the RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
## Rule

When a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or Larkspur Valuables Floater of the customer takes effect during the renters term while the RentGuard Renters Policy premium carries no multi-policy discount, the discount restarts and the renters policy is owed a restart credit, posted as one return premium entry with change reason multi-policy discount change and credit basis pro rata dated the effective date of the new qualifying policy.

The restart credit is not posted until the premium account carries a multi-policy discount change charge dated the closed date of every qualifying policy that ended earlier in the same renters term.

Put the other way round: for each Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or Larkspur Valuables Floater of the customer that shows a closed date earlier in the same renters term, the renters premium account must already show a multi-policy discount change charge dated that closed date before the restart credit is posted; where the premium account does not yet show such a charge for one of those closed dates, the restart credit is not posted.

| What the records show | Restart credit |
|---|---|
| A new umbrella or floater took effect during the renters term; the renters premium carries no multi-policy discount | Owed, as one return premium entry dated the new policy's effective date |
| A qualifying policy ended earlier in the same renters term and the premium account carries a multi-policy discount change charge dated its closed date | The restart credit may be posted |
| A qualifying policy ended earlier in the same renters term and no multi-policy discount change charge dated its closed date is on the premium account | Not posted |

## Posting reference: `post_discount_restart_credit_e779526e`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool posts the multi-policy discount restart on one RentGuard renters policy. One call records a single return premium entry on the policy's premium account with the reason multi-policy discount change on a pro-rata basis, dated the effective date given, for the amount given; it lowers the policy's premium balance by that amount and restates the policy's annual premium to the figure given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` naming `post_discount_restart_credit_e779526e`, then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool` with the arguments below.

**Parameters.**

- `renters_policy_id` — reference number of the RentGuard renters policy record being credited, as returned by the renters policy lookup for the customer (text id).
- `effective_date` — the date the discount change takes effect, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time zone); recorded as the effective date of the credit.
- `restated_term_premium` — the annual premium the policy carries once the discount has restarted, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded half-up to the cent.
- `amount` — the return premium credited for the restart, in USD with 2 decimal places, a positive figure already rounded half-up to the cent.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new premium account entry reference, the amount credited in USD with 2 decimal places, its effective date, the restated annual premium and the premium balance now standing. Receiving it means the credit is posted; the credit, the lower balance and the restated annual premium are then visible.
